priorityList: Apply Arcane Intellect and Mirror Image before combat begins.
Cast Frostfire Bolt and Meteor (if available) just before the pull to generate initial resources.
Activate Combustion while finishing a cast (Frostfire Bolt, Pyroblast, or Flamestrike) or while a Meteor is in flight.
Use Potion, Trinkets, and Racial abilities (Berserking/Blood Fury) once Combustion is active and has more than 6 seconds remaining.
Use Meteor during Combustion (ideally within the first 8 seconds if Burnout is talented).
During Combustion, spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike if there are 4 or more targets and you have the Fuel the Fire talent; otherwise, use Pyroblast.
During Combustion, spend Pyroclasm procs on hard-cast Flamestrike (4+ targets) or Pyroblast (1-3 targets) only if the cast will finish before Combustion expires.
Use Scorch during Combustion if Heat Shimmer is active or if the target is below 30% health (with Scald talent) to maintain flow.
Use Fire Blast off-GCD to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak, specifically while mid-cast or during Combustion/Hyperthermia windows.
When Combustion is on cooldown, use Meteor if its cooldown will reset before your next Combustion window.
Outside of Combustion, spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike (4+ targets) or Pyroblast (1-3 targets).
Hard-cast Pyroclasm procs outside of Combustion only if the Combustion cooldown is longer than 12 seconds or if you have reached 2 stacks of the buff.
Use Scorch as a filler if Heat Shimmer procs or to execute targets below 30% health.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your primary filler to generate Heating Up and Frostfire Empowerment procs.
In AoE, ensure Flamestrike is only used as a spender if you have the Fuel the Fire talent; otherwise, prioritize single-target spenders to ignite targets.
